## Working session summary

The work for issue #227 is complete and PR #228 is marked ready for review: https://github.com/link-assistant/calculator/pull/228

**What the PR delivers**

- **Case study** in `docs/case-studies/issue-227` with the competitor inventory, the natural-language quote corpus in several languages, requirements R1–R7 with solution options, component and crate review, and the measured coverage report.
- **Automated coverage checker** `scripts/competitor-coverage.mjs` that runs all three corpora through the CLI, reports supported, different, unsupported and timeout per source and language, and fails on regressions against the committed baseline. It has node:test unit tests.
- **Corpus importer** that extracts single-expression assertions from the fend, libqalculate, Numbat, Rink and math.js test suites.
- **18 sub-issues** (#229 to #246) created, linked as sub-issues of #227 through the GitHub API, with blockers registered through the dependencies API. The milestone issue #246 is blocked by the other 16 feature issues.

**Measured baseline** on v0.22.0 across 3055 corpus rows:

| Status | Rows |
|---|---|
| supported | 640 (20.9%) |
| different | 213 |
| unsupported | 2202 |

**CI status**

The first two runs failed on two jobs. The missing changelog fragment was fixed in the docs commit. The Dependency Freshness job failed because seven web packages had new releases published after main last passed on Oct 3, which the repo's convention from PR #226 treats as an error. I bumped those packages to the latest versions, verified the 229 web unit tests and the TypeScript build locally, and documented the bump in the changelog fragment and the PR description. The run for the final commit passed every job, including Web Build with the new Vite version.

The branch is level with main, the working tree is clean apart from the intentionally untracked `ci-logs/` directory, and there are no comments on the issue or the PR to address. ## Working session summary

I resolved the merge conflicts, re-checked every requirement of #227, and updated the docs. PR #228 now has no conflicts, all its checks pass, and it is ready for review: https://github.com/link-assistant/calculator/pull/228

**Conflicts.** All 13 conflicting files were shared with `main`: the coverage checker, the corpus importer, the corpora, the baseline and report, `.gitignore` and the web `package.json`/lock. The sub-issue PRs had already merged newer versions of them into `main` (#248–#253, #259), so I took `main`'s version of each. The PR now adds only the parts `main` doesn't have:
- the case-study README
- the 18 sub-issue specifications with `issues.json`
- the issue snapshot
- `create-sub-issues.mjs`
- a changelog fragment, rewritten to list only these additions

**Requirement check.** Each requirement in #227 is met either by a file in the case study or by a sub-issue:
- **Closed sub-issues:** 7 of the 18 (#229–#235), each by its own PR.
- **Blockers:** the 37 "blocked by" links are still registered on GitHub, unchanged.
- **Open work:** #236–#245 (the feature sub-issues) and the final acceptance issue #246.

I added a "Progress since the plan was filed" section to `docs/case-studies/issue-227/README.md`:
- **Whole corpus:** 2010 of 13,975 rows supported (14.4%).
- **Original 3055 rows:** 891 supported, up from 640. Silently wrong answers are down from 213 to 195.
- **Fixed examples:** I ran the original ones through the new build: `3,000 minus 12` → 2988, `200 + 10%` → 220, `10m × 10m` → 100 m², `2 amperes times 5 ohms` → 10 V.
- **Worse statuses:** five rows got worse (`0.1 + 5%`, `4 Metres`, `4 mEtRes`, `cbrt (1kg)`, `sqrt(2m)`). Each change is intentional and documented in the case studies for #234 and #235.

The overall percentage is lower than the 20.9% first reported because the corpus grew about 4.6 times, mostly with features that are still open.

**PR description.** Something had re-added `Fixes #229`…`Fixes #246` to the body. Merging with those lines would have closed the 11 open sub-issues, so I removed them and rewrote the description. Merging now closes only #227.

**Checks.**
- **Local:** the coverage check reports no regressions against the baseline, all 129 script tests pass, and the required-docs and file-size checks pass.
- **On the PR:** the security, link and CodeQL checks all pass.
- **Not run:** the main CI/CD pipeline. The PR now changes only docs, the changelog and `experiments/`, and the workflow only runs when code, corpus or workflow files change.

There are no new comments on the issue or the PR, and the working tree is clean.
